Name: Bearded Clint - Portraits
Author: cathysaurusrex
Description:
I wasn't a fan of Clint with the goatee, so I added a little more foliage to his face. Both the portrait and sprite (a separate upload) are tested and working. :)

HOW TO USE THIS MOD:
- Go to your Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits folder and back up your vanilla Clint.xnb file elsewhere in case you want to revert in the future
- Download the modded Clint.xnb file
- Extract the Clint.xnb file into the Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits folder
- Load the game and go visit the blacksmith to check out his new look!

Don't forget to download the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/408/?]accompanying bearded sprite[/url]!
